ruling.recommended_action: Refund $2.40 (1.70 km × $1.41/km) for the unexplained off-route segment as a Ryde voucher; record the RD-1 shortest-route breach on the driver file and note that the $1.04 meter waiting charge for the rider-requested Clementi Mall stop stands.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 14:21–14:30 driving 3.80 km where the optimal route covers 2.10 km (+1.70 km, up to 555 m off route). The rider-requested stop at Clementi Mall is named, so the stop is not a detour under RD-3(a), but the request covers only stopping, not a 1.70 km routing change (RD-3(b)); no pre-deviation route agreement in chat (RD-5); no qualifying traffic incident on the optimal route (RD-4(a); F12/F13 bands are corroboration only per RD-4(b), and F14 shows no incidents). Unexempted under RD-1, refunded per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Only the unexempted segment's 1.70 km is refundable under RD-2; the remaining 0.30 km of billed excess distance (F1 +2.0 km vs F4 +1.70 km, within the 0.25 km matching residue allowance) is not refunded.
RydeTAXI waiting time is charged by the meter (RD-3(c)); the 4-minute stop at the rider-named Clementi Mall was rider-requested and rider-caused, so the $1.04 stands.
Speed band 4 on Ayer Rajah Expressway, on a different named road, is at best corroboration and cannot exempt a segment on its own (RD-4(b), G3).
Light rain (1.8 mm) is not a 'reasonable cause' for leaving the shortest and most direct route under RD-1/RD-4.
